name: MongoDB Atlas
description:
Manage MongoDB Atlas and query your data directly through Claude. Connect to any MongoDB cluster or Atlas project to run queries and aggregations, inspect schemas and indexes, and read/write documents - all through natural language.

Key features:

* Query and manage data - Run finds, aggregations, and counts; insert, update, or delete documents; create collections and indexes.
* Manage Atlas infrastructure - Create and upgrade clusters, manage database users and IP access lists, and inspect cluster metadata across your projects and organizations.
* Optimize performance - Get index suggestions, schema recommendations, and slow query analysis from the Atlas Performance Advisor.
* Build streaming pipelines - Create, monitor, and manage Atlas Stream Processing workspaces, connections, and processors.
* Search MongoDB knowledge - Query official MongoDB documentation and expert guidance directly from the assistant knowledge base.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MongoDB Atlas to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MongoDB Atlas to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mongodb.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MongoDB Atlas MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MongoDB Atlas lists 41 MCP tools, including aggregate, aggregate-db, atlas-create-access-list, atlas-create-cluster, atlas-create-db-user, atlas-create-free-cluster, atlas-create-project, atlas-get-performance-advisor, atlas-inspect-access-list, atlas-inspect-cluster, atlas-list-alerts, and atlas-list-clusters.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MongoDB Atlas?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MongoDB Atlas in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does MongoDB Atlas MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: MongoDB Atlas requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MongoDB Atlas is developed by MongoDB. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
